scripts.build: npm run build -w @arcremit/shared && npm run build -w @arcremit/chain && npm run build -w @arcremit/db && npm run build -w @arcremit/api && npm run build -w @arcremit/web && npm run build:landing
scripts.build:landing: npm install --prefix apps/landing --no-audit --no-fund --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build --prefix apps/landing
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @arcremit/api" "npm run dev -w @arcremit/web"
